cli.cmd.root.short: TMAegis - AI-Powered Cross-Platform CIS Hardening & Compliance Engine
cli.cmd.root.long:
TMAegis is an open-source, declarative security hardening and compliance tool
built for SysOps, DevOps, and SecOps teams. It supports Linux, Windows, Databases,
and Multi-Cloud environments with built-in state snapshots, rollback safety,
extensible plugins, and BYOK/Local AI analysis (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama).

cli.cmd.apply.short: Apply CIS hardening remediations with automatic state snapshot
cli.cmd.rollback.short: Restore system configuration to a previous state snapshot

cli.cmd.gui.short: Open the local web interface (127.0.0.1 only, protected by a random per-run token)
cli.cmd.gui.long:
Starts a local web GUI embedded in this binary. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, makes no
external requests and requires the per-run token printed below. Applying changes needs
administrator/root privileges. Press Ctrl+C or use the Quit button to stop it.
cli.flag.gui.port: Port to listen on (default: a random free port)
cli.flag.gui.no-browser: Do not open a browser; just print the URL
cli.flag.gui.lang: Initial UI language, e.g. vi, ja, zh-Hans (default: detected from the system)
cli.flag.gui.open-timeout: Exit if no browser has connected within this time (0 disables)
cli.flag.gui.idle-timeout: Exit after this long without any UI activity or running job (0 disables)
cli.flag.root.no-color: Disable colored output (also honored: NO_COLOR, TMAEGIS_NO_COLOR; FORCE_COLOR forces color)
cli.flag.root.ascii: Draw with plain ASCII instead of Unicode symbols and box characters (also TMAEGIS_ASCII=1)

cli.cmd.root.example:
# Audit this Ubuntu 24.04 host against level-1 rules
tmaegis scan --target linux --os-family ubuntu-24.04

# Audit an exported Cisco IOS configuration and write an HTML report
tmaegis scan --target cisco-ios --device-config running-config.txt -f html -o report.html

# Preview the fixes without changing anything
tmaegis apply --target linux --dry-run

# Show the help in Vietnamese
tmaegis --help --lang vi
cli.cmd.scan.example:
# Local audit with the styled summary
tmaegis scan --target linux --os-family ubuntu-24.04

# Machine-readable output for CI (stdout stays plain JSON)
tmaegis scan --target linux -f sarif > tmaegis.sarif

# Network device from an exported configuration
tmaegis scan --target cisco-ios --device-config running-config.txt

# Remote host over SSH (read-only)
tmaegis scan --ssh admin@10.0.0.5 --target linux
cli.cmd.apply.example:
# Preview every change first
tmaegis apply --target linux --dry-run

# Apply with a snapshot and a 120-second dead-man's switch
tmaegis apply --target linux --deadman-timeout 120
